verdict.rationale: Gusto's platform docs say it automatically calculates and files taxes and handles 'all associated federal, state, and local filings and payments,' including multi-state requirements and tax calculations through bank transfers. That covers calculation, filing, and remittance. One community report describes a W-2c filing error that double-reported payroll to the IRS, but it shows an error in practice rather than a missing capability. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on local tax jurisdictions and remittance mechanics, and independent hands-on corroboration that filings are accurate.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have federal, state, and local payroll taxes calculated, filed, and remitted automatically

citations.quote: Handle all aspects of payroll management including regular payroll runs, off-cycle payments, termination processing, and all associated federal, state, and local filings and payments.
But Gusto Embedded does the heavy lifting for you, handling everything from tax calculations to bank transfers.
